title: 第一卷 第2425章 极阴冥骨第一卷 第2424章 趁机敲一笔
content_zh:
;;
阴阳庙，一共五重庙宇。
但跟纸庙的三重庙宇不同，是同心圆的结构，最深处第五重庙宇，便是其最中间的位置。
而此刻叶蓁他们所在的区域，便是阴阳庙第五重庙宇的门户所在。
距离林辰，还有不短的距离。
阴阳庙第一重庙宇，建造得十分的雄伟壮观，抬头望去，是如同云层一般的穹顶，寻常肉眼甚至都看不到穹顶的图案。
而支撑着穹顶的，是一根根数十人合抱的巨大柱子，每一根都是一体的巨木所制，也不知生长了多少年才能如此巨大。
林辰行走其间，可以感受到阴阳之力流动的变化。
“这里的每一根柱子，都是处于阵眼位置，共同组成了一座大阵，最初夏侯家探索此地，可是折损了不少人手，这才确定了最佳路线”，林辰道。
他并不是径直往前走去，而是按照特定的路线往前，甚至步伐与速度，都在有意的控制，否则，也会引来这座大阵的排斥。
“即便是我，也很难寻到更好的路线了，而且势必耗费不短的时间”，林辰道。
他能够感受到大阵的可怕，当然不愿轻易去尝试。
如此，林辰顺着路线，一路走到了池水边。
这池子，就是进入第二重庙宇的入口。
“这是极阴寒池，里面的水全部都是极阴之力所化，寻常生灵进入其中，体内阳气顷刻间就会被耗尽，直接成为冰冻的人干”，白书道。
这池子，很恐怖！
最初阴阳庙并没有这样的布置，是因为后续神名殿堂遭遇了重创，将毁灭，阴阳庙祝这才启动了阴阳庙内的防御措施，导致阴阳庙内一步一险。
其余神庙也是如此。
否则若是正常状态，外来者进入庙中，除开个别核心区域之外，并不会遇到什么凶险。
“夏侯家炼制的阴阳破禁丹便可抵挡这极阴之力的侵蚀，而只要沉到池底，便可通过池底的阴极门，进入第二重庙宇！”林辰道。

这些步骤，夏侯徳给他们的图纸之上便有呈现。
有成熟的方法，通过这里并不难。
等到谢诗莹他们适应了这里的环境，就可以通过此地。
林辰站在极阴寒池边上，站了一会儿，随即抬头看向穹顶。
“辰辰，怎么了？”白书问道。
这里已经被夏侯家摸索透了，没有什么秘密可言，照着夏侯家的路子走下去才是最正确的解法。
而这一点，林辰也是认可的。
不过夏侯家却也不一定能够探尽此地秘密。
阴阳庙，阴阳之力都是同时出现的，这第一重庙宇也是如此，巨柱与穹顶共同组成的大阵，也是叫做阴阳惊天阵，以阴阳二力同时驱动。
但这里却有一口极阴寒池。
只有纯粹的极阴之力。
并没有极阳之力与之对应。
如此阴阳失衡，并不符合阴阳庙的特性。
“神庙内，应该有着极阳之力与之呼应，但夏侯徳给我的图纸中，并没有极阳之力的所在”，林辰道。
要么是夏侯家也没有寻到。
要么就是夏侯徳在有意隐瞒。

Yin Yang Temple, a total of five temples.
But unlike the three-layered temple of the paper temple, it has a concentric structure, and the fifth-layered temple at the deepest point is the middle position.
At this moment, the area where Ye Zhen and the others are located is the entrance to the fifth level of the Yin-Yang Temple.
There is still a long way to go from Lin Chen.
The first level of the Yin Yang Temple is very majestic. Looking up, you can see a cloud-like dome. The pattern of the dome cannot even be seen with the naked eye.
What supports the dome are huge pillars hugged by dozens of people. Each pillar is made of a giant tree. It is unknown how many years it has grown to become so huge.
As Lin Chen walked along, he could feel the changes in the flow of yin and yang power.
"Every pillar here is at the eye of the formation, forming a large formation together. When the Xiahou family first explored this place, they lost a lot of people, and then they determined the best route," Lin Chen said.
He did not walk straight forward, but followed a specific route. Even his pace and speed were deliberately controlled. Otherwise, he would be rejected by this formation.
"Even for me, it's difficult to find a better route, and it will definitely take a long time," Lin Chen said.
He could feel the terror of the formation, and of course he was unwilling to try it easily.
In this way, Lin Chen followed the route and walked all the way to the edge of the pool.
This pool is the entrance to the second level temple.
"This is the Extreme Yin Cold Pool. All the water in it is transformed by the power of Extreme Yin. When ordinary creatures enter it, the Yang Qi in their bodies will be exhausted in an instant, and they will directly become frozen human stems," Bai Shu said.
This pool is terrifying!
Initially, the Yin-Yang Temple did not have such an arrangement. This was because the Hall of God's Name suffered heavy damage and was about to be destroyed. Only then did the Yin-Yang Temple Zhu activate the defensive measures in the Yin-Yang Temple, causing the Yin-Yang Temple to be in danger every step of the way.
The same goes for the rest of the temples.
Otherwise, if it is normal, outsiders entering the temple will not encounter any danger except for a few core areas.
"The Yin-Yang Forbidden Breaking Pill refined by the Xiahou family can withstand the erosion of this extreme Yin power, and as long as it sinks to the bottom of the pool, you can enter the second level temple through the Yin Gate at the bottom of the pool!" Lin Chen said.
These steps are shown on the drawings given to them by Xiahou De.
There are proven ways and it's not difficult to get through here.
After Xie Shiying and the others adapt to the environment here, they can pass through this place.
Lin Chen stood at the edge of the Jiyinhan Pond for a while, then looked up at the dome.
"Chenchen, what's wrong?" Bai Shu asked.
This place has been explored thoroughly by the Xiahou family. There are no secrets. The most correct solution is to follow the Xiahou family's path.
And Lin Chen also recognized this.
However, the Xiahou family may not be able to explore all the secrets of this place.
In the Yin and Yang Temple, the power of Yin and Yang appears at the same time, and the same is true for this first-level temple. The large formation formed by the giant pillars and the dome is also called the Yin and Yang Jingtian Formation, which is driven by the two forces of Yin and Yang at the same time.
But there is an extremely cold pool here.
There is only pure yin power.
There is no corresponding extreme Yang power.
Such an imbalance of yin and yang is not in line with the characteristics of the yin and yang temple.
"In the temple, there should be the power of the extreme sun to echo it, but in the drawings Xiahou De gave me, there is no place for the power of the extreme sun," Lin Chen said.
Either the Xiahou family didn't find it either.
Either Xiahou De was deliberately hiding it.
